title: LEGO® The Lord of the Rings™
notes: Opened a previous save file, explored the open world, and completed the Gandalf vs. Saruman story level. Ran very well overall with minor stutters at first. Fixed by disabling Depth of Field, Motion Blur, and Bloom in-game, and setting textures and shadows to Low/Medium. Played smooth after that.
issues: Ran very well overall, but had occasional slowdowns/stutters. Lowered in-game settings (disabled Depth of Field, Motion Blur, Bloom, and set shadows to Low/Medium), and after that it played completely smooth.
